one_line_thesis: Aehr Test Systems sells wafer-level burn-in systems into SiC and memory cycles; at $77.36 the proof-first component value ($9.79/sh base) implies -33.31% annual return on mid-cycle owner cash — watch until shipment recovery is filing-confirmed.

deep_dive.executive_summary: At $109.89 (Yahoo close 2026-08-04), our base case annual return is -36.67% per year over seven years on mid-cycle normalized owner cash $0.16 per share. Aehr is a cyclical burn-in equipment supplier with FOX-XP/WaferPak specialization. FY2026 closed at $50.0 million revenue and a $7.1 million GAAP net loss, but Q4 and bookings show an inflection: $18.8 million quarterly revenue, record bookings, and about $100.6 million effective backlog into FY2027 guidance of $130–$150 million. Cash is $116.5 million after dilution. Component base value remains far below spot. Moat is stable in a focused...
